Definition: to catch (in a net, trap or pit); generally, to capture or occupy; also to choose (by lot); figuratively, to cohere
BiblicalUsage: 1) to capture, take, seize; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to capture, seize; 1a2) to capture (of men) (fig.); 1a3) to take (by lot); 1b) (Niphal); 1b1) to be captured; 1b2) to be caught (of men in trap, snare) (fig.); 1c) (Hithpael) to grasp each other
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
